_comment: Provider-literal ratchet (G1). Per-file occurrence count of provider-ID references in core. May only go DOWN. Regenerate: node scripts/check-provider-literal-ratchet.mjs --write. Every counted file must have an `allowlist` entry (count, reason, owner, diesAt); the entries are authored by hand and survive --write. Delete this file and the guard when empty.

apps/cli/src/commands/spend.ts.reason: Hermes spend analysis: the CLI names the dedicated ACP provider used by the fork's review transport.
apps/cli/src/commands/spend.ts.diesAt: when spend analysis selects the registered provider without a literal fallback

apps/demo-server/src/fixtures/providers..reason: demo fixtures: the demo server's static provider roster.

apps/demo-server/src/fixtures/world.ts.reason: demo fixtures: the demo world's default provider.

apps/host-daemon/src/runtime-manager.ts.reason: fork provider runtime: the Claude Code adapter retains its provider-specific runtime configuration.
apps/host-daemon/src/runtime-manager.ts.diesAt: when provider runtime configuration is resolved through registered provider metadata

apps/server/src/internal/fork-unread-eve.reason: legacy Codex timeline compatibility: unread-event filtering recognizes the historical provider shape.
apps/server/src/internal/fork-unread-eve.diesAt: when all legacy Codex timeline rows have migrated to provider-neutral metadata

apps/server/src/services/threads/thread-.reason: legacy persisted data: pre-v3 codex timelines recorded the native turn id with no checkpoint; the fallback reads them.
apps/server/src/services/threads/thread-.diesAt: legacy-tool-item-backfill migration (stamps the checkpoint onto old rows)

packages/config/src/bb-app-managed-confi.reason: BUNDLED_PROVIDER_IDS: the legacy `customAcpAgents` reader refuses an agent id that shadows a bundled provider, AND `customModelProviderIdSchema` (live `customModels` config) accepts only a bundled id or an `acp-*` id, so a third-party provider cannot carry custom models today (documented DEBT in the file).
packages/config/src/bb-app-managed-confi.diesAt: the reader with LEGACY_CUSTOM_AGENTS_REMOVED_IN (0.41); the enum when customModels accepts any registered provider id

packages/db/src/data/thread-spend.ts.reason: spend accounting compatibility: the fork's Codex usage rollup preserves the legacy provider-specific token fields.
packages/db/src/data/thread-spend.ts.diesAt: when spend rollups read provider-neutral usage dimensions

packages/scripts/src/commands/archive-co.reason: ops script for codex temp sessions: names the `codex` executable, not a provider branch.

packages/scripts/src/lib/seed-perf-fixtu.reason: perf fixture generator: seeds threads for two providers so the timeline benchmark covers both shapes.
